claim: Lutiq is a predictive landing-page system for paid commerce traffic: generate on-brand variants, owner-approve what may run, predict a page per click, measure against a live holdout.
definition: Lutiq generates on-brand landing page variants for paid traffic, the brand owner approves what may run, and for every click the system predicts which page to show — measured against a live holdout.
product_description: Lutiq generates on-brand landing page variants for paid traffic, the brand owner approves what may run, and for every click the system predicts which page to show — measured against a live holdout.
caveats: Not unsupervised AI rewrites of a live site without approval.
Primary measurement claim uses a holdout, not only relative A/B winners.
